Role: city Manager
Industry: Retail
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: for every query we have a ticket is being assigned
Cons: it take time to close the ticket as same ticket id is rolled out among otherexecutive.
Comments: In our company for any issues related to IT,HRBP, Or Finance related queries we have to raise ticket in Freshdesk. it will assign to particular department and person will assigned to that concern we raised. and track the work done.

Role: Technical Representative
Industry: Construction
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It's very responsive and logs all of my conversations to my MIS team.
Cons: Nothing negative I have to say about it. It would be cool to be able to put a feature where your message is very important or an emergency so that is pushed to the top priority.

Role: Head of Marketing & Communication
Industry: Events Services
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: As a marketing professional I only use Freshdesk to manage our FAQs so this is what I'm reviewing. The knowledge base is very complete and intuitive. A very good experience overall.
Cons: Nothing to report in my experience using this product. But my team mentioned the price sometimes being an issue when needing to add more team members ot our account.

Role: Assistant Manager - International Sales
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The user interface is really easy to use. Even a fresher can easily adapt and start using. Also, we like the reporting capabilities, which are very useful when we are in at Managerial Position.
Cons: The price is a bit high and the integrations provided are limited.
Comments: We use to deal with our clients. The support team is using it on a daily basis to track the requests and provide a full customer satisfactory response within no time. Good product for an organization that need to deal with a customer support system.

Role: Co-founder
Industry: Information Technology and Services

Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: It’s great for when your customer support department is starting off - very inexpensive, fairly straightforward
Cons: Sometimes slow web app performance and the user experience isn’t always great - can sometimes be confusing
Comments: Overall it’s a great product that I would recommend mostly for small teams and new companies

Role: CEO

Cons: Bulk action can get better, easier I am sure responding UI can get better with app
Reasons for choosing: Ease of setup and all integrations
Reasons for switching: Cost

Role: Software developer
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Intercom is a complete live chat application for businesses. It is extremely easy to use. I found the chatbot feature to be useful, but I think it is only useful for some businesses such as retail businesses, or businesses that can use the information from a customer to see what they want to sell them. I would recommend using Intercom for businesses that need live chat but are not using it already.
Cons: I am a marketing strategist, and my company is growing. I have come to realize that I need to engage with customers in an effective way to obtain leads and generate sales. I have tried many different marketing strategies in the past, but none have been as effective as LiveChat. I am able to create a LiveChat session with customers and obtain leads. I've had great results and I'm satisfied, I haven't had a problem. In general it [truncated]

Role: Human Resources Generalist
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Streamlining the process of submitting and responding to tickets, and developing automated tools to streamline and simplify our daily lives. I appreciate how simple it is to locate articles and macros to distribute to my clientele. The addition of emoticons and gifs to the discourse is a nice touch, as well.
Cons: Previous software allowed us to see the customer's input before he sent it. This allowed us to quickly respond to his query by reading it as he was writing it. If only I could keep seeing it.
Comments: Quickly and simply, I can access the Macros and write/update the articles in the assistance center. Streamlining the process of submitting tickets to the correct division for handling user concerns. It's a time saver for all teams because they can deal with it themselves.
Reasons for switching: [sentence mentioning [truncated]
